text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-98765 — us-west-az5 capacity loss (auto-detect). Severity: P1. Symptoms: serving node preemptions, model shard evictions, increased 5xx and request queueing. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-98765 :rotating_light:

oncall-alice: acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it. pulling metrics now.

sre-bob: seeing ~30% pod churn in us-west-az5 over last 6m, kvcache eviction spikes, qps normal but p99 token latency up 3x.

eng-runtime-charlie: thanks — this smells like spot preemption cascade on the autoscaler. can we confirm instance termination events?

oncall-alice: checking infra events... running quick query: 
```
gcloud compute instances list --filter="zone:(us-west-az5) AND status:TERMINATED" --limit 50
```

oncall-alice: yep, multiple preemptions from one host pool, ~12 nodes terminated in last 5m. autoscaler tried to replace but throttled by quota.

eng-runtime-charlie: ok — plan: 1) throttle new routing to us-west-az5 (divert to az8/az9) 2) request emergency quota bump / reserved pool attach 3) pin critical model shards to surviving nodes 4) rollback any recent rollout if present.

support-danielle: customer-facing: support page shows tail errors for some customers in US-West. All customer-facing incidents need ETA and mitigation note. I'll draft a blurb after we know divert % and ETA.

pd-bridge-bot: INC-98765 updated: oncall-alice acknowledged at 1702509999; assign to eng-runtime-charlie. Escalation level: 1 -> 2 (15m elapsed).

sre-bob: starting automated divert: set routing policy weight: us-west-az5 -> 0.3, us-west-az8 -> 0.5, eu-west-az3 -> 0.2. command: 
```
redwood-routing set-weight --region us-west-az5=30 --region us-west-az8=50 --region eu-west-az3=20 --change-reason "autoscaler preemptions us-west-az5"
```

oncall-alice: routing change applied. monitoring for error rate.

eng-runtime-charlie: also bump worker pool from spare-reserved-1 -> spare-reserved-2 to absorb shards. I opened internal request: infra-ticket#4521.

support-danielle: draft status for customers: 
"We are investigating increased errors in the US-West region. Traffic is being routed away from the affected zone while we restore capacity. No data loss expected. Updates every 15 minutes."

oncall-alice: adding mitigation action: temporary disable of batch background prewarm to reduce eviction pressure. command: 
```
redwood-runtime update-config --batch-prewarm=false --scope=us-west-az5
```

eng-runtime-charlie: done. also pinning the LLM shard placements: 
```
redwood-orch pin-shard --model shard-ml-03 --nodes node-21,node-23 --ttl 30m
```

sre-bob: after divert + prewarm off, 5xx rate dropped from 4.2% -> 1.1% over 4m, p99 latency trending down but still 1.6x baseline. autoscaler still reporting "throttled quota" when trying to provision.

eng-runtime-charlie: authorizing manual scaling of reserved pool: infra please attach reserved-pool-urgent for +10 nodes to us-west-az5.

oncall-alice: infra confirmed reserved pool attach scheduled, ETA ~8m. will update when attached.

pd-bridge-bot: INC-98765 escalated to on-call SRE tech lead (sre-bob) at 1702510300.

support-danielle: posting to customers: ETA 10-15m for stabilization; using the wording we agreed. sending now.

eng-runtime-charlie: after attach, re-set routing weights gradually back: target us-west-az5 -> 60 over 10m window if p99 < 1.2x.

sre-bob: reserved pool attached at 1702510700. nodes came up healthy. eviction counts dropping.

oncall-alice: monitoring shows recovery: 5xx down to 0.3%, p99 at 1.05x baseline. rolling back routing weights to normal over next 8m.

support-danielle: sent follow-up to affected customers: services restored, apologizing for the temporary disruption.

eng-runtime-charlie: root cause hypothesis: spot/preemptible batch in the same host pool without graceful drain + aggressive autoscaler+quota limits. action items: 1) add preemption-aware placement policy 2) raise fault-domain isolation for model-serving pools 3) improve autoscaler backoff on quota errors 4) postmortem owner assigned.

oncall-alice: assigning postmortem to eng-runtime-charlie; target draft in 48h. closing pager duty alert in 30m if stable.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert INC-98765 acknowledged and annotated. History: routing divert -> reserved-pool attach -> prewarm disabled -> shard pin -> recovery.

sre-bob: leaving follow-up notes in incident ticket. ping me if anything re-surges. :eyes:
